build_combined_roidb_for_training: build a roidb by loading and concatenating region proposal databases for one or more datasets with optional object proposals
create_flipped_entries: create horizontally flipped copies of each roidb entry including boxes, segmentations, and keypoints for data augmentation
filter_roidb_for_training: filter roidb entries to remove images with no usable foreground or background RoIs based on config thresholds
compute_bbox_regression_targets: compute bounding-box regression targets for each roidb entry using IoU overlap between example and ground-truth ROIs
review_roidb_stats: review and log ground-truth class histogram statistics across all entries in the roidb for debugging
